<!-- pr-reviewer: d2342eff6f6c0401d98742b624b0f85927c0cd81 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge. This review covers head d2342eff6f6c0401d98742b624b0f85927c0cd81.

## What looks good

- The fix answers issue #1655. A note names the skipped band. A test pins it. This matches the "Done means" line of the issue.
- The band finder (`machining2d::unreached_pieces` / `unreached_note`) is pure and lives in `camcraft-motion`. `app` calls it once after generation (`keep_law::narrow_noted`). The split follows the code-shape laws.
- The note never blocks the cut. When the band check fails, the path stays and a note says the check did not run. The code also logs that fact. Nothing fails silently.
- Noise slivers (narrower than 0.01 mm, or under 1e-4 mm²) get no note. An empty region and a NaN reach return without an error or a note.
- The new module and the new test file carry a provenance line. No `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!` exists outside test code in this diff.
- Test placement is correct. `crates/app/tests/narrow_band.rs` imports app fixtures, and its gate map names `app::operation::keep_law`, `app::operation::generate`, and `motion::machining2d`. The motion law tests live in the crate that owns the code.
- `docs/decisions/1655-narrow-band-note.md` gives the reason for the note: a cut past the stock edge would move every around-part pocket and its goldens.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #1655`. The commit subject is conventional.
- No new cross-crate dependency. No process file. No snapshot PNG. No golden file.

## Results merged with main

These ran on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43628791434. The run trial-merged the head with main at `058e14ca0b36e0e270d6300dfeb0ab3e323b06c9`.

| Lane | Result |
|---|---|
| Quick gate - motion suites (the lib arm carries the new `unreached` law tests) | pass, 191 s, 0 failed |
| Quick gate - app suites (includes the new `narrow_band` suite) | pass, 521 s, 0 failed |
| Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

An earlier pr-test run at this same head failed (run 43621045352). Its trial merge used main `4f4edcf35465c3ee83d7d4197685fc0e661e52f1`. That main held the two red stock-source tests of issue #1691. The fix PR #1692 merged at 18:44 UTC. The run above uses that fixed main, and those suites pass. That earlier failure is main red (#1691), not a defect in this PR.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `unreached_note` says "some bands" when it finds two or more pieces. Give the exact count instead, for example "2 bands".
- The body names what it did not exercise: the 3+2 tilted frame, inch units, 2D Offset, and the trochoidal method of 2D Adaptive. All use the same call site. A follow-up test for one of them is welcome.
- `generate.rs` is already far over 400 lines. This PR adds 4 lines to it. This is growth only, not a blocker.
- Note for the maintainer: the task brief for this review expected this branch to also remove the dead code of issue #1678. The head's diff does not contain that change. #1678 is an open UI issue and this branch does not reference it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Reviewer: general-purpose subagent, session model, no override. Independent of the author.
No escalation. Gate route: pr-test.yml on the self-hosted runner (run 43628791434, success); no local worktree build.
Blended upper estimate at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower.
